Reference / csv/input

csv/input#

A borrowed, bounded UTF-8 CSV document reader.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let input = CsvInput(file.reading(), CsvDialect(";", "'", "\n"));
let rows is @@string = input.read();

Description#

A borrowed, bounded UTF-8 CSV document reader.

Construction binds dependencies and validates nonnegative limits; it does not read. read() consumes through EOF and returns rows only after complete UTF-8 and CSV validation. It is an explicit synchronous operation, never a Cursor method. No newline normalization, BOM stripping or header inference.

Default bounds: 4194304 bytes, 1048576 input scalars, 65536 decoded field scalars, 10000 rows, 1024 columns. The two-argument constructor selects a dialect; the seven-argument constructor also specifies those five bounds. Byte collection is checked before UTF-8 decoding; scalar/field/row/column limits are checked by CsvRows AFTER bounded collection. This reader does not promise incremental parsing or field-limit rejection before collecting EOF.

Each origin.bytes request is positive and <=4096. At the byte boundary we probe one excess byte to distinguish exact EOF. Excess is never appended to the private buffer. Short reads are accepted; oversized responses throw InvalidReading. UTF-8, CRLF and doubled quotes may straddle read boundaries. Source exceptions propagate unchanged. InvalidUtf8 offsets count bytes; InvalidCsv offsets count original Unicode scalars. No partial rows escape.

Repeated read() consumes remaining source data, not a cached snapshot. After stable EOF it returns []. Failures do not roll back consumed bytes: callers must not assume that retry restarts the document. Bounds reset per operation. The returned array is independent of source lifetime. CsvInput retains origin but NEVER calls its close(), including destruction and exception unwinding. Its local ByteBuffer owns no external resource. External source closure is observed on the next read. Shared/reentrant consumers require coordination.

Run tests: okkama run -t std/csv/input.ok

Public API#

object CsvInput#

object CsvInput

A whole CSV document read from a reader.

CsvInput.CsvInput#

CsvInput(origin is Reading)

Reads origin as comma-separated with CRLF, within 4 MiB read, 1 MiB of input, 64 KiB per field, 10000 rows and 1024 columns.

The same in dialect.
